22750-rags-the-story-of-a-dog.title: Rags The Story Of A Dog
22750-rags-the-story-of-a-dog.creator: Karen Niemann
22750-rags-the-story-of-a-dog.description: A book by Karen Niemann. The boxes belonged to a little boy named Gary. He was building a playhouse with them. And as soon as he had carried in the wood and swept the walks, he would call, "Grandma, everything's done! May I play in my box house now?"

arxiv-2107-08885.title: A new method of carbon budget analysis with application to present and paleo atmospheric concentration data sets
arxiv-2107-08885.creator: Alice Nadeau, Richard McGehee, Clarence Lehman
arxiv-2107-08885.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Alice Nadeau, Richard McGehee, Clarence Lehman. We introduce a new method for analyzing the carbon budget using box models and a mass balance approach. The method describes the net flow of carbon between the atmosphere and other reservoirs. The method assumes that the data can be explained by having the carbon move in and out of the atmosphere through two reservoirs, one consisting of isotopically light carbon (biotic) and the other consisting of isotopically heavy carbon (abiotic).

arxiv-2209-11936.title: Online Admission Control and Rebalancing in Payment Channel Networks
arxiv-2209-11936.creator: Mahsa Bastankhah, Krishnendu Chatterjee, Mohammad Ali Maddah-Ali, Stefan Schmid, Jakub Svoboda, Michelle Yeo
arxiv-2209-11936.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Mahsa Bastankhah, Krishnendu Chatterjee, Mohammad Ali Maddah-Ali, Stefan Schmid, Jakub Svoboda, Michelle Yeo. Payment channel networks (PCNs) are a promising technology to improve the scalability of cryptocurrencies. PCNs, however, face the challenge that the frequent usage of certain routes may deplete channels in one direction, and hence prevent further transactions.

arxiv-2210-09504.title: Proposal for non-cryogenic quantum repeaters with hot hybrid alkali-noble gases
arxiv-2210-09504.creator: Jia-Wei Ji, Faezeh Kimiaee Asadi, Khabat Heshami, Christoph Simon
arxiv-2210-09504.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jia-Wei Ji, Faezeh Kimiaee Asadi, Khabat Heshami, Christoph Simon. We propose a quantum repeater architecture that can operate without cryogenics. Each node in our architecture builds on a cell of hot alkali atoms and noble-gas spins which offer a storage time as long as a few hours. Such a cell of hybrid gases is placed in a ring cavity, which allows us to suppress the detrimental four-wave mixing (FWM) noise in the system.

arxiv-2407-08848.title: GCS*: Forward Heuristic Search on Implicit Graphs of Convex Sets
arxiv-2407-08848.creator: Shao Yuan Chew Chia, Rebecca H. Jiang, Bernhard Paus Graesdal, Leslie Pack Kaelbling, Russ Tedrake
arxiv-2407-08848.description: Abstract We consider large-scale, implicit-search-based solutions to Shortest Path Problems on Graphs of Convex Sets (GCS). We propose GCS*, a forward heuristic search algorithm that generalizes A* search to the GCS setting, where a continuous-valued decision is made at each graph vertex, and constraints across graph edges couple these decisions, influencing costs and feasibility.

arxiv-2510-21945.title: Generalization Bounds for Rank-sparse Neural Networks
arxiv-2510-21945.creator: Antoine Ledent, Rodrigo Alves, Yunwen Lei
arxiv-2510-21945.description: Abstract It has been recently observed in much of the literature that neural networks exhibit a bottleneck rank property: for larger depths, the activation and weights of neural networks trained with gradient-based methods tend to be of approximately low rank.

arxiv-2512-07051.title: DAUNet: A Lightweight UNet Variant with Deformable Convolutions and Parameter-Free Attention for Medical Image Segmentation
arxiv-2512-07051.creator: Adnan Munir, Shujaat Khan
arxiv-2512-07051.description: Abstract Medical image segmentation plays a pivotal role in automated diagnostic and treatment planning systems. In this work, we present DAUNet, a novel lightweight UNet variant that integrates Deformable V2 Convolutions and Parameter-Free Attention (SimAM) to improve spatial adaptability and context-aware feature fusion without increasing model complexity.

pmc-10726028.title: Surgical outcomes of endoscopic thyroidectomy approaches for thyroid cancer: a systematic review and network meta-analysis
pmc-10726028.creator: Xiaosong Li, Wei Ding, Hong Zhang
pmc-10726028.description: ObjectivesThis network meta-analysis assesses the outcomes of seven endoscopic approaches, offering valuable insights for researchers and practitioners in choosing the best method for thyroid cancer patients.MethodsA systematic literature search was conducted in the PubMed, Embase and Web of Science databases up to March 2023. The analysis included seven endoscopic approaches, with a focus on their respective outcomes through network meta-analysis.

pmc-12399859.title: Predictors, Healthcare Utilization and Costs Related to Short-Term Stays in Patients with COPD: A Registry-Based Analysis in Norway
pmc-12399859.creator: Tron Anders Moger, Jon Helgheim Holte, Olav Amundsen, Silje Bjørnsen Haavaag, Øystein Døhl, Line Kildal Bragstad, Ragnhild Hellesø, Trond Tjerbo, Nina Køpke Vøllestad
pmc-12399859.description: BackgroundChronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) incurs significant healthcare costs, often accompanied by multimorbidity. Advanced patients may need short-term stays for rehabilitation, treatment, or respite to maintain home living.AimTo identify predictors for a first short-term stay and study the healthcare utilization and costs compared with similar patients without a short-term stay.

pmc-12578575.title: Social and occupational functioning scale for epilepsy: performance in Brazilian adult patients with epilepsy
pmc-12578575.creator: Gloria M. A. S. Tedrus, Danilo Wingeter Ramalho, Elisa Dal Rio Teixeira
pmc-12578575.description: BackgroundEpilepsy is a condition that can lead to social difficulties and restrictions.ObjectiveTo evaluate social and occupational functioning and relationships with clinical findings of Brazilian adult patients with epilepsy.MethodsThe scores of the Social and Occupational Functioning Scale for Epilepsy (SOFSE) were related to the clinical data of adult patients with epilepsy.

pmc-13198455.title: Phenomenology of Subjective Anomalous Experiences in People with Schizophrenia
pmc-13198455.creator: Orlando Mondragón-Benítez, Lina Díaz-Castro, Fernando Corona-Hernández, Héctor Cabello-Rangel
pmc-13198455.description: Current diagnostic criteria for schizophrenia overlook the patient’s subjective experience, offering a simplified view. To describe the subjective anomalies in the personal experience of the “lived world” in patients diagnosed with schizophrenia via the EAWE interview (Examination of Anomalous World Experience). A qualitative study was conducted between January and May 2024.
